ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (35) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

«Провидение» (providenie, 'providence') is lowercase as in the source; «вечный жид» (vechny zhid, literally 'the eternal Jew') is given its established English name, the Wandering Jew. In Marcus Aurelius the clause «и по смыслу таких случайностей есть здравие и цельность мироздания» (literally 'and according to the meaning of such accidents there is the health and wholeness of the universe') reads as garbled and is translated as printed.

Source observation: [10] «и по смыслу таких случайностей есть здравие и цельность мироздания» ('and according to the meaning of such accidents there is the health and wholeness of the universe') looks garbled (perhaps for «ибо смысл таких случайностей есть…», 'for the meaning of such accidents is…'); translated as printed
